svg.title: How one phase is built
svg.desc: Every group of a phase starts from the state S that the earlier phases left. A group that runs commands is an exec on S; its layer is what it changed. A group that only copies is built on an empty state. The conflict check compares the layers. If the groups are independent, their layers are merged onto S, and the next phase starts from the result. Otherwise the build stops and names the groups and paths.
